rationale: Adds a shared opt-in dock boundary for position-only sources and changes the stable vacuum path contract to prefer complete integration data/session information over local dock/grace heuristics. Also fixes stale current geometry after an explicit native empty, present in v1.81.0; not merely a repair of an intermediate feature.

summary.ru: Путь пылесоса следует данным интеграции; для отдельных позиций можно включить новый трек после базы.
summary.en: Vacuum paths follow integration data; position-only sources can start a new path after docking.
